entry.title: einkreader 0.6.13: Forwarded newsletters stay readable
entry.content:
• Substack newsletters forwarded or sent to your @einkreader.app address keep their whole text, with their title, byline and images, instead of being replaced by the publication's subscribe page.
  • Pictures that link to a larger version show as pictures, not as a stray "!".

entry.title: Author profiles on the web
entry.content: • On the web feedback page, an author's name or avatar opens their profile.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.12: Reading settings: font, margins and page turns
entry.content:
• New Reading section in Settings, with a live preview: text size, margins, and four fonts (Serif, Literata, Sans-serif, Atkinson Hyperlegible).
  • Turn pages instead of scrolling: articles move a screen at a time, with "← Page 2 / 5 →" at the bottom. Swipes and page keys turn pages too.
  • The text size is now remembered.

From your feedback: Paginated scrolling

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.11: Know when someone answers your feedback
entry.content:
• The feedback icon shows how many new replies and reactions your feedback got; threads with news are marked "new".
  • Feedback is now readable on the web at einkreader.app/feedback, and there is a contact page.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.10: Backups that don't freeze the app
entry.content:
• Backing up a large library no longer makes the app unresponsive; a progress bar shows how far along it is.
  • Settings show when your last backup was made, and how big it was.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.9: Ready for the Play Store
entry.content:
• The Play Store version is signed for release.
  • Tidier website addresses: /privacy, /opensource, /brand.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.8: X sign-in built into the Play Store version
entry.content: • The Play Store version connects to X (Twitter) without needing your own developer key.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.7: Feedback loads by itself
entry.content:
• The feedback list loads and refreshes on its own.
  • Screenshots are attached to article feedback only when you ask, and open full screen.
  • A more compact Inbox, with an "Other senders" filter.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.6: Account deletion
entry.content:
• You can delete your profile and your @einkreader.app address, from the app or the website.
  • Fixed sharing by email.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.5: Faster feedback, simpler setup
entry.content:
• Feedback opens instantly from what's saved on your device.
  • Adding a source starts by picking its type: RSS, X or Nostr.
  • Creating a profile starts with your address, checked as you type.
  • Inbox comes first in the filters and in your sources.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.4: Instant feedback posting
entry.content:
• Posting feedback is instant; offline, it waits in the outbox.
  • A more compact feedback list.
  • Tapping a name opens a fuller profile with their highlights and feedback.

From your feedback: Posting feedback should be instant

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.3: A quieter feedback link
entry.content:
• The feedback button under articles became a discreet line of text.
  • A simpler feedback form that shows clearly who you post as.

From your feedback: Feedback on feedback feature

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.2: The Inbox
entry.content:
• Links, newsletters and PDFs emailed to your @einkreader.app address land in a new Inbox, filtered by sender.
  • Mail from new senders waits for you to accept it.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.1: Feedback with screenshots
entry.content: • Send feedback with a subject, a link and a screenshot, right from any article.

entry.title: einkreader 0.6.0: Public feedback
entry.content:
• Share ideas and bugs with everyone from the app, reply in threads and react with emoji.
  • A brand page with logos and images at einkreader.app/brand.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.10: Lighter X bookmark sync
entry.content: • X bookmarks are fetched 10 at a time, and only as far back as needed.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.9: X sign-in fixed
entry.content:
• Fixed signing in to X on e-ink devices getting stuck in a loop.
  • Only new bookmarks are fetched; the debug log is quieter.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.8: Instant link menu
entry.content:
• Tapping a link opens its menu instantly, even offline.
  • Errors that need X reconnected offer a button to do it.
  • The Read tab is sorted by when you read each article.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.7: Better X posts and articles
entry.content: • Links to X posts show the post itself; more articles extract cleanly.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.6: Resume reading follows your filters
entry.content: • Resume reading sits below the filters and shows only what they select.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.5: Readable X errors
entry.content: • Problems with X are explained in plain sentences.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.4: Source errors you can see
entry.content: • A source that fails to update shows a warning, and X can be reconnected from its feed.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.3: Older websites
entry.content: • Articles from table-based sites (like paulgraham.com) extract properly.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.2: Quotes keep their shape
entry.content: • Paragraph breaks and list lines survive in quotes.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.1: Instant sharing
entry.content: • Sharing a highlight closes the dialog at once and publishes in the background.

entry.title: einkreader 0.5.0: Simpler sharing
entry.content: • A button at the end of an article shares all your highlights from it.

entry.title: einkreader 0.4.12: Download status
entry.content: • Articles show whether they're downloaded; the Read and Highlights tabs filter by source.

entry.title: einkreader 0.4.11: Tweets that share links
entry.content: • A short tweet sharing a link brings in the linked story.

entry.title: einkreader 0.4.10: Friendlier offline messages
entry.content: • Clear messages when you're offline, everywhere; an Advanced section in Settings.

entry.title: einkreader 0.4.9: Cleaner articles
entry.content: • Stray style code no longer shows up as text in articles.
